gate_results.rationale: Authoritative review facts indicate a duplicate capability exists (shared_api_platform) triggering IT-RATIONAL-001 (ASSESS_EXISTING_CAPABILITY), and technology end-of-life is within 8 months (< 12 months) triggering IT-EOL-001 (CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN). Both findings mandate a REWORK disposition at the opportunity phase.

All architecture governance criteria are satisfied in the authoritative review facts: no IP address overlap (ip_overlap=false), governed API gateway is present (api_gateway_present=true), accountable data owner is defined (data_owner_present=true), measured latency of 15ms is well within the 100ms target (measured_latency_ms=15, latency_target_ms=100), workload business criticality is Medium (not High or Critical), and reversibility design is documented (reversibility_status='documented'). No candidate architecture findings apply, resulting in a GO disposition.

Security architecture review identified 1 open critical vulnerability requiring remediation (critical_vulns_open: 1), security logs not exported to SIEM (logs_to_siem: false), and WAF operating in detection-only mode for an internet-exposed workload (waf_mode: Detection). Per the decision policy, open critical vulnerabilities require a NO_GO disposition.

Technical readiness assessment identified multiple failures against operational and quality thresholds: measured restore time of 42 hours exceeds the 24-hour RTO (TR-RTO-001), measured data loss of 2880 minutes exceeds the 1440-minute RPO (TR-RPO-001), load testing only reached 50% of expected peak (TR-LOAD-001), 2 critical static-analysis code findings remain unresolved (TR-CODE-001), and 3 production blockers remain open (TR-BLOCKER-001). Under the normative policy, these findings mandate a REWORK disposition.

Authoritative review facts reveal that requested funding exceeds the approved envelope (budget_requested_eur: 1500000 > budget_approved_eur: 1275000), triggering GEN-BUDGET-001 (SUSPENSION). In addition, upstream decisions show that the security gate returned NO_GO, triggering GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (NO_GO). Under the priority ordering of the normative policy, NO_GO supersedes SUSPENSION. Authorization is required for NO_GO.
